title: RCMP releases name of choking victim
article: The RCMP has released the name of a young man who died during a drug bust in Whalley on July 31.
Brandon Whitelaw, 22, of Surrey, choked on a plastic bag containing unknown substances.

Whitelaw was arrested with another man. The RCMP drug squad had been investigating a residence on Ravine Road for drug trafficking when they decided to follow a car that left the location. The driver was stopped for traffic infractions, and the police also arrested the pair under the Controlled Drug and Substances Act.
Insp. Garry Begg said Whitelaw went into "medical distress" shortly after being handcuffed because his windpipe was blocked. Police, firefighters and paramedics tried to save him.
Police had yet to identify what was in the bag.
The integrated homicide investigation team investigates in-custody deaths.
